subject.title: Browserbase integration broken: static cdpUrl returns 404, needs session API

question: Should OpenClaw ship first-party Browserbase session lifecycle support now, wait for a generic browser backend/plugin seam, or only correct the Browserbase docs until the credential/session contract is settled?
rationale: The issue is valid, but the permanent fix defines service-specific browser session lifecycle, credential storage, signed URL redaction, and possibly public profile-driver/config surface, so automation should not choose that contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Revise the Browserbase driver PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83306 as the starting point, but require route-wide `connectUrl` resolution, redaction, credential-surface approval, rebase, and live browser-tool proof before merge.

options.title: Route through generic backend seam
options.body: Keep this issue open behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/19289 and avoid a Browserbase-specific driver until browser backend registration has a versioned Plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Docs-only correction for now
options.body: Remove or qualify the static Browserbase recommendation so users are not sent to a broken or secret-bearing workflow while product direction remains unsettled.

recommendation.title: Revise the Browserbase driver PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83306 as the starting point, but require route-wide `connectUrl` resolution, redaction, credential-surface approval, rebase, and live browser-tool proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the browser plugin ownership, CDP policy, docs, and plugin-boundary surfaces affected by the decision.
